title: Dave Canales: I've never seen a LB play better than Devin Lloyd on Sunday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dave Canales: I've never seen a LB play better than Devin Lloyd on Sunday
sources.description: There was a lot for Panthers head coach Dave Canales to like about the way his team played in Sunday's 34-3 win over the Falcons and linebacker Devin Lloyd's performance was at the top of the list.
